definition_strict: Dev-scene ground-truth classes only (data/*/ground_truth.json), mapped through the closed vocabulary. Fully GT-derived, narrow here.
definition_project_like: Written list of project-like classes: everyday household and office objects present in the labelled set; structural items (wall, floor, ceiling, window, outlet, shadow, reflection) and dataset oddities (stickers, pods, garment parts) are excluded by this written decision.
